_comment: Block registry. Order sets the numeric id (air is 0); saves store names, so ids may change between builds. tex: one texture name, or {top, side, bottom}. render: cube | cross | liquid | none. layer: opaque | cutout | translucent. filter: extra light lost passing through (leaves, water). hardness: seconds to mine with the builder's steel tools.
